description: Open a customer return against a shipped sales order — the order page's Create return. Each line names the sales order line (or SKU) and how many units come back; a line can return at most what shipped minus what is already on a return. Service lines cannot be returned. issue=true (default) also issues it, which routes it to Waiting approval until someone approves it in the app; it can be received once approved. Nothing moves in stock yet. Two-step: preview=true, then commit with the previewReceipt.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

issue.description: true (default) issues the return (it then waits for approval); false leaves it created.

lineId.description: The order line to return (GUID): a sales order line id from get_sales_order for a customer return, a purchase order line id from get_purchase_orders for a supplier return. Either lineId or sku is required.

quantity.description: Units to return, in the line's unit of measure (> 0).

reason.description: Optional reason, shown on the return line.

sku.description: Item SKU on the order; must match exactly one line.

note.description: Optional internal note on the return.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is written until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit.

salesOrderId.description: Sales order id (GUID) or number from get_sales_orders.

warehouseId.description: Optional warehouse id (GUID) the units come back to; defaults to the order's store warehouse.

name: create_customer_return
title: Create Customer Return
